ns2:course.label: Advanced Undergraduate Open Seminar
ns2:course.description: Independent study course covering topics not treated by regular course offerings. This class does not satisfy departmental graduation requirements. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Junior or senior standing; ECON 302; ECON 202.
